enforcement_authority: Information Commission (successor to the Information Commissioner's Office under DUAA 2025 Part 6)
deceased_data: Not covered: personal data means data on an identified or identifiable living individual (s. 3(2))
research_exemption: Exemptions from access, rectification, restriction, objection for research/statistics (Sch. 2 para 27) and archiving in public interest (para 28), where rights would prejudice purposes
genetic_data: Special category data (UK GDPR art. 9; defined art. 4(13)); needs art. 6 basis plus art. 9 condition, and DPA Sch. 1 condition where required
notes: Amended by Data (Use and Access) Act 2025; new ICO powers in force 2026-02-05 (SI 2026/82)
